description: Declared editorial risk, not observed model failure rates or public-code popularity. First matching group wins. Eval mentions are computed independently from prompt and attached fixture only, never expected answers or catalog text.

risk_groups.why: Data loss, purchase entitlement and chat filtering have security, moderation or economic consequences.
Timing, animation replication, collision/query semantics and engine-only settings can break gameplay or authority assumptions.
Input, UI, character, localization and object-lifecycle changes affect ordinary game scripts and player experience.
Other entries remain ranked; restricted/undocumented APIs receive an explicit penalty rather than being omitted.
